text: {"name":"llc_conn_status_check","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Returns the default status unless the LLC gates permit scanning, then reports whether the first matching connection has a zero status byte in the indexed connection table.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"result":"status","v1":"conn_env"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"Pointer to the indexed connection table"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Connection-list head"},{"offset":17,"meaning":"Nonzero gate that causes an immediate zero return"},{"offset":18,"meaning":"Scan proceeds only when this byte is at most 1"},{"offset":0,"meaning":"Next link in the connection list"},{"offset":106,"meaning":"Connection state compared with 2"},{"offset":1224,"meaning":"Marker required to be nonzero for a match"},{"offset":1225,"meaning":"Index into 140-byte connection-table entries"},{"offset":133,"meaning":"Per-entry status byte tested for zero"}]}
